newsitem.title: USA: Sano Corp says gets license for Nestorone.
newsitem.headline: Sano Corp says gets license for Nestorone.

text.p: Sano Corp said Thursday it received from the Population Council Inc an exclusive license for the North American rights to use Nestorone in transdermal patches for female hormone replacement therapy and contraception.

The company said studies conducted by the non-profit Population Council have shown Nestorone can be developed for use alone or in combination with an estrogen, both for contraception and hormone replacement therapy.

The company said the license also includes an option to secure the exclusive, worldwide rights for the transdermal use of a patented, synthetic androgen for the treatment of testosterone deficiency and muscle wasting in males and male contraception.
The company said plans to file an Investigational New Drug application on the combination patch and begin human clinical trials by the end of 1997.
It also plans to file an IND on a Nestorone transdermal patch for female contraception.
